long_biography.plain_text:
Michael Lee Johnson Goff entered a fuel enterprise established by his great-grandfather Herbert in 1888. The company had shifted from general trading into petroleum products before his tenure. Appointed to the board of George J. Goff Limited by 1991, he later assumed directorships across affiliated heating, buying-club and distribution businesses.

The group expanded from its Norfolk and Suffolk base into a wider regional operation and relocated to purpose-built premises in Wymondham. Its related companies cover domestic and commercial heating oil, boiler services and collective purchasing. As fourth-generation chairman, Goff oversees operating companies that combine fuel distribution with heating services and group buying.
